distribution.narrative: Beaver & Liu (2010) treated the historical Taiwan attribution as doubtful. The record was based on Shiraki material; the species is otherwise known from Sri Lanka and the Taiwan occurrence was considered highly improbable/uncertain. No confirmed Taiwan occurrence is promoted.

host_note: No host evidence is reported for this doubtful Taiwan record; no host is promoted from Beaver & Liu (2010).
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Craniodicticus mucronatus Blandford, 1895.

nomenclature_note: Current identity is Craniodicticus mucronatus Blandford, 1895, VSN_1620. The uncertainty concerns Taiwan occurrence, not taxon identity.
